title: Soft Algebras via Bulk Double Soft Limits
summary: Soft and collinear limits of "celestial amplitudes" give rise to infinite dimensional symmetry algebras for two-dimensional (2D) "celestial" conformal field theories (CFTs). A small subset of these operators generates the action of the entire set recursively via the commutation relations. Insertion of this subset into celestial CFT correlators gives the boundary version of the first three terms in a soft expansion of the corresponding 4D bulk gravitational scattering amplitude.
